primary_question: On held-out synthetic families never used in Gate 1, does proxy R_leverage add Spearman information for tau_EXPLORE beyond entropy and belief margin?
primary_estimand: Delta_R = Spearman(M1, tau) - Spearman(M0, tau) on holdout_families
pass_rule: leakage pass AND cluster-bootstrap CI of Delta_R excludes 0 with point>=0.05 AND calibration ECE of R vs 1[tau>delta] <= 0.25 AND equal-budget top-k utility of R >= entropy at k matching 25% acquisition rate AND false EXPLORE rate under mu>=0.75 does not increase by more than 0.10 vs entropy
fail_rule: any confirmatory clause fails; recoverability remains diagnostic telemetry (SUCCESSOR_A)
calibration_on: calibration_families; may not select among many formulations
